options.message: This issue action has been replaced by versioned contract issuing.

sql.query: UPDATE tbl_generated_contracts gc SET gc.status='issued',gc.issuedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,gc.issuedByUserId=:userId,gc.modifiedByUserId=:userId2,gc.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status='draft' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_contract_document_clauses dc WHERE dc.contractId=gc.id AND dc.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND dc.clauseBehaviour='mandatory' AND dc.isIncluded<>1) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.issue' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
